title: Pool/Boat git token lacks read:project, so issue flows can't move project Status
body: From #10220: Secret Manager `coder-pool-git-token` lacks the `read:project`/`project` scope, so runs on Boat/GCE land and close issues but can't update the OpenAgents board (project 19) Status. Document the needed scopes in docs/cloud/boat-chat-work.md and docs/cloud/gce-pool.md, and make the flow say once (not fail) when Status can't be set. Rotating the token with the right scopes is an owner step (add to NEEDS_OWNER.md).
